sources.facts: Srinagar District identifies the fort on the west of Dal Lake, distinct from the older Mughal walls constructed under Akbar.

The Srinagar Master Plan treats the summit fort and Nagar Nagar city wall as separate heritage structures. The standing fort is from the Afghan era and has been conserved by the Directorate of Archives, Archaeology and Museums.
The tourism directorate documents surviving summit fortifications on Sharika Hill and the surrounding sites. Text only.
